Thread an optional dirty-borrow lender into the detector. When present, the
k=3 detector MCX uses the in-tree `mcx_dirty` (Barenco "surrounded" 4-CCX form,
one **borrowed and restored** ancilla) instead of `mcx_clean_k` (2 CCX + one
fresh clean ancilla). The lender is the already-live `active` lane, which is
neither a detector control nor the gate, so it is a valid dirty borrow and is
restored on every detector edge (enforced by `mcx_dirty`'s per-shot contract
checks). This removes the `mcxk_t3` allocation that defined the 851 peak.

### Files changed
- `arith/khattar_gidney.rs`: new `unary_iterate_log_star_borrowed` +
  `detector_mcx` helper (dispatches to `mcx_dirty` for k in 3..=5 when a valid
  lender is supplied, with an aliasing guard that falls back to `mcx_clean_k`).
- `inversion/register_shared_eea_reference.rs`: `for_each_forward` /
  `for_each_reverse` pass `Some(active)` as the lender.
- `trailmix_port/mod.rs`: re-hunted tail nonce + matching op-capacity hint.

## Tail nonce

The borrow cut changes the op stream, so the Q851 nonce (4114534) no longer
keeps this stream support-clean. Re-hunted with the in-tree count-only hunter
(`TRAILMIX_TAIL_NONCE_SEARCH`, `HASH_OPS_LEN=834829709`):

- **`TRAILMIX_TAIL_NONCE = 1049`** (source-baked), support model **8 miss /
  21 repair** — below the validated Q851 baseline of 13 miss / 43 repair.
